observation.subject: GET /management/info
observation.sentence: `GET /management/info`: warm median 2.4 ms over 12 requests; all of them reached no handler BootUI marks (an Actuator endpoint, a request the security filters answered, or a servlet outside Spring MVC), so the time is not split into phases. First request 14 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Open the slowest exemplar request in Live Activity to see its timeline and recorded calls.
observation.unlistedReason: Its time is not split into phases, since its requests reached no handler BootUI marks or named nothing at all, and its warm median is under 20 ms.
